edges: Input IDs, positions and state handles

traces.title: One request
traces.intro: Follow a prompt through its first token and the next decode step.
steps: Render the declared template and encode text to token IDs.
Admit the request and assemble positions, sequence IDs and state handles.
Prefill the prompt and advance the committed position.
Project the final hidden state into vocabulary logits.
Apply the sampling contract and commit a token. Feed that token and its position to the next decode iteration.
Use the sampled token and the existing sequence state for the next decode step. Compare its logits with full-context recomputation.
Decode committed vocabulary IDs, retaining incomplete byte sequences until a complete text segment is available.
Emit decoded text in order, deliver the finish reason and complete the request.
On stop or cancellation, retire the sequence and release its claims after outstanding work completes.
Release the final sequence-owned pages only after the device has completed its last read. Test that a second request cannot observe stale state.

traces.title: One MoE token
traces.intro: Follow authoritative routing through weight readiness and the inverse token permutation.
steps: Rank routed experts with the checkpoint rule. Record selected IDs and aligned mixture weights.
Pack rows by expert and preserve the inverse mapping.
Force an incorrect prefetch. Join or fetch the actual selected weights and wait for readiness.
Evaluate each selected expert’s gate, up and down projections.
Restore token order, apply each aligned mixture weight once, and compare the per-token sum against an unfused reference.

traces.title: Slow decode
traces.intro: Use a matched workload. Start with the symptom and distinguish queue delay, weight waits and device execution.
steps: Separate time to first token from steady inter-token gaps. Record client and engine clock boundaries.
Inspect ready-to-run delay, active sequences and token budget. Long queue wait with idle GPU time suggests admission or host scheduling.
Correlate demand timestamps with weight-ready events. Count missed bytes, wait time and overlap at the actual tier boundary.
Compare CPU submission, device start and completion. Inspect occupancy and measured bandwidth at the observed shape.
Repeat with fixed input lengths, concurrency and cache state. Attribute nested or overlapping intervals on a timeline before ranking causes.

traces.title: Build a router
traces.intro: Apply one reusable CC to a new tree or an existing engine.
steps: Freeze the model routing rule, allowed device paths and correctness oracle.
Inspect existing hooks for routing scores, expert IDs, weights and token layout. In an empty tree these become explicit interface obligations.
Implement a reference selector. Preserve the checkpoint scoring rule, routed width and dispatch interface.
Add a fast selector only for qualified shapes. Test ties and fallback on an unsupported width.
Compare selected IDs, weights and the merged residual against independently computed expected values.
Record which code, model, shapes and device passed. Reopen work for an unqualified target.

traces.title: Storage miss
traces.intro: Trace a cold expert from disk to a verified FFN output.
steps: Bind expert tensors to checked storage byte ranges.
Budget live weights after KV, workspace, staging and headroom. Refuse an infeasible tile.
Route the token to an expert that is absent from the cache.
Read the demanded bytes, join duplicate fills and publish a handle after the final copy.
Wait for the handle, compute the selected expert and release its slot after last use.
Force misses with a working set larger than the cache. Compare against a small reference fixture and measure actual storage bytes, peak memory and exposed wait.

traces.title: Compare quantizations
traces.intro: Follow one precision-policy change from frozen quality gates to the lab verdict.
steps: Freeze the reference, candidate tensor precision policy, held-out quality gates, device budgets and target workload.
Record a per-tensor format manifest. Use the supplier’s pinned checkpoint or export a candidate with isolated calibration data.
Verify the pack identity, tensor metadata and byte ranges before mapping bounded windows.
Decode edge-value blocks independently and qualify the scale convention before exercising fused multiplication.
Observe the kernel actually selected for the format and shape, including any fallback or workspace expansion.
Measure real expert bytes, capacity and storage misses under the same demand trace.
Score matched held-out prompts and report the quality delta and uncertainty alongside measured memory, latency, throughput and bytes from storage.
Return the pinned artifacts and pass, fail or inconclusive verdict to the planner. Quality regressions remain visible in the RSI record.
